title: Faith of Our Fathers
description: Faith of Our Fathers in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Frederick William Faber and James George Walton, first published in 1849. The tune, ST. CATHERINE, is by Henri Frederick Hemy. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Faith of our fa_-thers, liv_-ing still, In spite of dun-geon, fi-re and sword; O how our hearts_ beat high_ with joy When-e'er we hear that glo_-rious Word! Faith of our fa-thers, ho-ly faith! We will be true to thee till death.

lines: Faith of our fathers, living still,
In spite of dungeon, fire and sword;
O how our hearts beat high with joy
Whene'er we hear that glorious Word!

verses.label: Refrain
lines: We will be true to thee till death.
Faith of our fathers, we will strive
To win all nations unto Thee;
And through the truth that comes from God,
We all shall then be truly free.
Faith of our fathers, we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife;
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how
By kindly words and virtuous life.
